MC_playerclass_description_i18n.Warrior: You are a Warrior. You might be young, but you have seen more than your share of bloody battles. You are stronger in fights and for protecting the brothel.
MC_playerclass_description_i18n.Wizard: You are a Wizard. People bend to your will, and your magic. You have access to the most spells.
MC_playerclass_description_i18n.Trader: You are a Rogue Trader. You've been hustling since you were a young street rat. You can make better deals and fetch the best prices.

MC_stat_description_i18n.strength: This is the current strength of your character. Improves security and helps in individual fights.
MC_stat_description_i18n.spirit: This is your magic fortitude. Spirit is the source of your mana, and improves spell results during events.
MC_stat_description_i18n.charisma: This covers your character personality, looks and oratory skills. Improves results during interactions.
MC_stat_description_i18n.speed: This is your character's level of energy. Increases the number of actions you can perform.

god_description_i18n.Arios: You worship Arios, god of Light and lord of the Angels. +1 to Strength.
god_description_i18n.Shalia: You worship Shalia, goddess of Shadows and ruler of the Night. +1 to Spirit.
god_description_i18n.null: You do not worship any god, and delight instead in the wonders of the natural world. +1 to Charisma.

alignment_description_i18n.good: Your actions have shown you to be a {b}good{/b} person. Love-based interactions with your girls are more successful than fear-based ones.
alignment_description_i18n.evil: You are an {b}evil{/b} man, and revel in your own cruelty. Fear-based interactions with your girls are more successful than love-based ones.
alignment_description_i18n.neutral: You are {b}neutral{/b}, and would rather maintain balance between your own interests and those of others. Love and fear-based interactions are equally successful.
